# Terry Boxuan Xu {#welcome}


Welcome to my portfolio for **MUSA 5080: Public Policy Analytics** at the
University of Pennsylvania.

This site documents my work in the Master of Urban Spatial Analytics program —
weekly notes, course assignments, and a final project applying data analysis to
urban policy questions.

## About Me


I am a student in the Master of Urban Spatial Analytics (MUSA) program at the University of Pennsylvania with a background in architecture. I am interested in developing a comprehensive understanding of urban data science and its applications in cities.
